content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-97 (service bundled into another paid service), a coding/bundling issue rather than a medical-necessity dispute — which is why the prior medical-necessity appeal failed and returned CO-97 again. Retro-auth isn't offered and auth isn't required here anyway, and the original claim was denied (not paid), so resubmission won't trigger the CO-18 duplicate rule. The correct remedy for a bundling edit on a distinct service is to add an appropriate unbundling modifier (e.g., -59/XU) and resubmit the corrected claim.", "action": "correct_and_resubmit"}
